ITEM 1 | Leafy green mixed salad, dark green curly/flat leaves with some lighter pale green pieces, dressed with a slight sheen, piled loosely in a mound about 10 cm across and 3 cm tall, covering roughly 20% of the plate, with thin white and red-rimmed radish slices and small pale onion-like bits mixed through | 90
ITEM 2 | Yellow citrus wedges, bright yellow-orange flesh with slightly glossy, slightly browned edges, cut into segments about 3-4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, arranged along the upper right of the salad, covering roughly 10% of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Cauliflower florets, pale ivory to light golden with some browned spots and a dry, slightly grainy surface, bite-sized clusters about 3-4 cm across, piled in a mound about 9 cm across and 2.5 cm tall on the lower right, with a small reddish-brown bit visible at the edge, covering roughly 18% of the plate | 110
